name: @embedpdf/tooling-build
description: The one build preset for EmbedPDF v3 publishable TS packages: epdf-build derives entries from publishConfig.exports and produces dual ESM+CJS plus declarations via tsdown; epdf-check proves the packed tarball with publint + attw. Framework-platform tools (ng-packagr, svelte-package) and the wasm runtime stay outside this preset on purpose.
